summary: Backend + frontend regression tests passed for SEC-001/002/003/004 and the new Leads & Campaigns bulk-select features. 13/13 backend pytest cases green, both bulk-delete flows verified end-to-end in the browser.

minor.issue: The public preview ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on GET /api/* regardless of Origin header. FastAPI itself (localhost:8001) is correctly restricted by the SEC-001 allow-list, and preflight (OPTIONS) responses are correctly filtered even through the ingress. Because 'ACAO: *' combined with 'ACAC: true' is rejected by browsers, credentialed CORS abuse is still blocked at the browser level — but the '*' response is misleading and should be tightened at the ingress/proxy layer. Reproduce: curl -sI -H 'Origin: https://evil.example.com' <PUBLIC_URL>/api/  → shows ACAO=*. Same call to http://localhost:8001/api/ shows no ACAO header (correct).

action_items: Track (or dismiss with docs) the ingress-layer CORS override that returns 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' on the public URL. Backend code is compliant with SEC-001; this is an infra/proxy config issue and not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py SEC-004 fix is clean — the 'not verify_password ... hash_password' overwrite branch is gone; a clear inline comment explains why. Idempotent role/approval_status patch preserved.
lib/rate_limit.py mask_phone() keeps the last 2 digits — sufficient for triangulation without leaking full number. Fail-open behaviour on Mongo blip is documented.
applications.submit_application uses two-tier rate limit (5/hr + 30/day) — good defence-in-depth.

leads.bulk_actions_leads / campaigns.bulk_delete_campaigns correctly write to db.activity_log via lib/activity_log.log_event (field name is 'type' not 'event_type' — worth noting for future test scripts).

server.py CORS block combines allow_origins list (static/capacitor schemes) with allow_origin_regex for prod/preview/localhost — correct pattern to avoid the ACAO:'*' trap while keeping mobile schemes working.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (bulk-select UI + bulk-delete flow verified for both Leads and Campaigns)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_security_and_bulk.py (pytest, 13 cases). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_security_and_bulk.py -v. Notes: (1) The rate-limit test consumes the 5/hour budget for the caller IP, so the autouse fixture wipes db.rate_limits at start AND end of the session — do not remove that. (2) CORS tests hit http://localhost:8001 directly because the public ingress adds ACAO:'*' on GETs; test_preflight_evil_blocked stays on BASE_URL because OPTIONS is correctly handled by the ingress. (3) activity_log field is 'type' (NOT 'event_type'). (4) There is no GET /api/leads/{id} endpoint — use the list endpoint or the _lead_by_id helper in the test file. (5) Frontend bulk-delete confirmations use window.confirm() so Playwright must attach a `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` handler.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found. The only observation — ingress-layer ACAO:'*' — is an infra/config artifact, not an application-code issue; browsers will still reject credentialed cross-origin requests to an ACAO:'*' response, so SEC-001's threat model (credentialed data theft) is mitigated at the browser boundary.
